description: This file defines a template class 'Client' for WebSocket communication, including connection management functions and logging, within the WebSockets namespace.

classes.name: Client
classes.description: A template class managing WebSocket client connections, supporting connect and disconnect operations, with callback handling.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection to the specified address, setting up callbacks for connection initialization and closure.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Closes the WebSocket connection and logs the disconnection process.
